name: Sitcom: Character Action Clip
description: Video preset for a character clip in the Sitcom look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second character clip. State the single action, the camera move, and the mood. Keep the character's design identical to the entity's description.
context_prompt: short clip of the character performing one clear action that shows personality, start and end pose readable, multi-camera sitcom still, bright even studio lighting, three-wall standing set dressed with lived-in detail, medium shot at eye level, high-key lighting with soft shadows, warm saturated colour, everything in focus, locked-off multi-camera coverage, cuts between medium shots, actors move within the set, no handheld
negative_prompt: dark moody lighting, cinematic shallow focus, horror, gritty grain, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
